description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM King Pins, King Pin Bearings and Shim Set for the Front Knuckle/Axle.
These will fit the top and bottom of the Knuckle on both side (LH & RH).
This Set will complete Both Sides.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Upper King Pin
Qty 2 – Lower King Pin
Qty 2 – Upper King Pin Bearing
Qty 2 – Lower King Pin Bearing
Qty 4 – Shims (0.05)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
